title: Pods: show what each Pod does, flatten navigation, make small Pods quick to create
goal: The owner sees purpose, last result, next run and problems of every Pod on the first surface, reaches every Pod setting in at most two clicks, and creates a small owner-tool Pod in under 15 minutes without workarounds.
summary: Replace the map-first, six-level Pod navigation with one row and one page per Pod, surface failures and pending approvals, and remove the creation obstacles measured on 13 October. New Pods run in owner context with the owner's HOME by default; the isolated sandbox is optional if the user wants it. Per-object push approvals still need an owner decision.

problem.statement: The main surface hides what Pods do and whether they fail; one Pod is spread over six levels; small Pods need workarounds to create.
problem.impact: Simple questions take up to five clicks, 137 failed PR-monitor runs look green, and new Pods take hours or bypass the sandbox.
problem.approach: One row and one page per Pod with purpose, result, next run and problems; visible pending decisions; fix logins, Shapes parsing and validation in the creation path.
problem.outcome: Every frequent owner task takes at most two clicks, and a Pod like the IURIO rebase Pod is created in under 15 minutes without workarounds.

context: Evidence: the Test Run https://report.openape.ai/d/01M4TMAJ72QHHYG876ZDH347P1 (45 inspected screenshots, navigation map, creation measurement 11:47 min with conditions). Confirmed owner observations: nesting without benefit, access overlays in the way, "Desktop online" without use, purpose not visible on the map, bumpy creation. Tags work because they are owner words, flat, on the first surface and one model everywhere; this plan applies that principle to purpose, state, settings and access. Quick wins Q1–Q9 of the report are independent of this plan.
scope: Desktop and browser shell of apps/openape-pods (central/*): rows, Pod page, decisions, settings.
Map read model fields for next run, waits-for, last result and failure counts.
Creation path: Shapes option parsing and git adapter, synthetic validation contract, MCP error messages, workspace command retries.
Owner context with the owner HOME as creation default, isolated sandbox optional if the user wants it; after owner decision: per-object approvals for program effects.
nonGoals: No change to the DDISA protocol; approvals stay at the IdP and Pods never approve themselves.
No removal of the isolated sandbox.
No phone inbox redesign; no in-app Pod creation.

decisions.title: Rows first, map second
decisions.description: The list of Pods with purpose, last result, next run and state becomes the default; the map stays as "Verbindungen" without edge labels.

decisions.title: One Pod page replaces dialog, developer block and tabs
decisions.description: A row click opens the page directly with sections Zweck, Läufe, Plan, Variablen, Zugriffe and a collapsed Code section. The hidden Pods inventory and the second back link are removed.

decisions.title: Groups become tags
decisions.description: Groups and tags classify the same Pods; existing groups migrate to tags and the group concept is removed.

decisions.title: Owner context with the owner HOME is the creation default; the sandbox is optional if the user wants it
decisions.description: Every new Pod runs in owner context: its programs and the Pod terminal get the owner HOME, so host CLI logins work without tool-specific setup (today HOME is always the Pod state directory: main/broker/tools.ts:80, main/programs/session.ts:93). The isolated sandbox is optional, if the user wants it: it can be chosen per Pod, at creation or later, because it sometimes makes sense from the start, but not always. Grants per command at the IdP are unchanged.
decisions.reference: Owner in chat, 2026-10-13: "Passt jetzt alles, aber owner Kontext soll jedenfalls beim erstellen eines pods Standard sein. Die sandbox Einschränkung ist das sicherheitshalber-Addon wenn die home implementation funktioniert und der User das will". Clarified the same day: "optional wenn der Usr das will". Denn manchmal macht das von Anfang an Sinn, aber eben nicht immer

decisions.title: One approval per push through per-object approvals
decisions.description: The approvals batch used for mail.archive accepts program actions such as git.push with the object branch@sha. Each approval is consumed by one push and expires when the object changes. Continuing grants stay for reads and other lasting permissions; they are not used to express one approval per push.
decisions.reference: Owner in chat, 2026-10-13, answering "Ist das so in deinem Sinn, also Entscheidung 4 = Objekt-Freigaben?": "Alles klar. Dann können wir so loslegen."

milestones.title: Owner decisions
milestones.goal: Decide decision 4 before M7 starts; decision 3 is accepted.
steps: Present per-object approvals against verified exact command grants.
acceptance: Decision 4 is recorded with the owner's wording in this plan.
milestones.rollback: No code change; nothing to roll back.

milestones.title: Pod rows with purpose, result, next run
milestones.goal: The first surface answers what each Pod does and whether it is fine.
steps: Add nextAt, waitsFor and lastResult to the map read model (worker/workspace/map-view.ts, contracts/map-view.ts).
Render rows in AutomationsList with purpose, result sentence, next run, waits-for, tags and a state chip; make it the default view.
Map: purpose as node tooltip, no edge labels; untagged Pods included unless deselected.
acceptance: Every active Pod row shows purpose, last result sentence, next run and waits-for; a Pod without purpose shows "Zweck fehlt".
Vitest browser-mode tests cover row content, states and geometry at 1280 px and 390 px and save screenshots as visual evidence.
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; the read-model fields are additive.

milestones.title: One Pod page
milestones.goal: Every Pod setting is at most two clicks from the main surface.
steps: Row click opens the page; remove AutomationDetail dialog, "Für Entwickler" and the CentralWorkspace inventory.
Sections Zweck, Läufe, Plan, Variablen, Zugriffe (sandbox and IdP grants of this Pod), Code collapsed; one back link.
Adapt scripts/verify-distribution.mjs and existing Electron specs that reference removed navigation; no new E2E tests for UI.
acceptance: Vitest browser-mode tests click through tasks 3, 5, 7 and 8 of the navigation map with at most two clicks each and save screenshots.
No surface contains a second "Details öffnen" or a second Pod list.
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; no data migration.

milestones.title: Problems and pending decisions visible
milestones.goal: Failures and waiting approvals show where the owner looks first.
steps: Error line in the run box and the row; KPI "Fehler 24 h" with per-Pod counts.
List pending IdP grants per Pod under Rechte with their IdP link, including grants requested through MCP.
One counter source for the KPI row and the Entscheidungen tab.
acceptance: A failed run shows its cause without expanding anything.
A pending push grant appears under Rechte and in the KPI; both tabs show the same number.

milestones.title: One settings page, tags instead of groups, honest loading
milestones.goal: Settings and classification exist once; loading never looks like a fact.
steps: Merge the ⚙ popover into one App-Einstellungen page; remove "Desktop online" (offline banner only).
Migrate groups to tags (schema change with backup), then remove groups.
Explicit loading states; keep the workspace in memory across navigation.
acceptance: Each account, session and backup control exists on exactly one surface.
Returning from a Pod page shows the list without a reload message.
milestones.rollback: Restore the pre-migration backup; revert the PR.

milestones.title: Creation path without rituals
milestones.goal: A small Pod reaches its first real dry run without adapter or validation workarounds.
steps: Shapes: bind option values only for declared options; support global options such as -C; ship a git adapter with worktree, merge-base and merge-tree.
Validation accepts a failed result with a reason, or is replaced by a real read-only dry run in the owner session.
MCP refusals name the field and its place; idempotent workspace commands retry on revision conflicts.
acceptance: The IURIO rebase test Pod is rebuilt from scratch in under 15 minutes with the shipped git adapter and no validation-only code, measured with timestamps.
Existing grants still match after the parser change (regression test on stored grants).
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; adapters are versioned files.

milestones.title: Owner context as creation default, sandbox optional
milestones.goal: Every new Pod uses host CLI logins; isolation is optional per Pod, if the user wants it.
steps: Set HOME to the owner home when reach is owner in main/broker/tools.ts and main/programs/session.ts; keep ~/.config/apes and the Pods folder protected; drop the per-program state directory for owner-context programs.
Make owner the default level for newly created Pods (MCP create and sandbox apply); existing Pods keep their current level.
Offer the isolated sandbox as an optional per-Pod choice, at creation and on the Pod page, whenever the user wants it.
acceptance: A newly created Pod runs in owner context without any sandbox setting, and az repos pr list works in it with the host login.
A Pod can be created directly in the isolated sandbox when the user chooses it.
Switching a Pod to isolated still blocks ~/.azure and keeps its grants unchanged.
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; new Pods fall back to isolated with the Pod HOME.

milestones.title: One approval per push
milestones.goal: Each program effect on one object needs its own IdP approval.
steps: Check the DDISA grants specification for object approvals of program actions; record any deviation for the owner.
Extend the approvals batch beyond mail.archive to git.push with object branch@sha.
acceptance: On a disposable test repository, a first push waits for one IdP approval and a second push to a new SHA waits for a new approval.
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; exact command grants remain the fallback.

risks.title: Owner HOME widens what a Pod can do
risks.mitigation: Owner decision (decision 3); IdP grant per command unchanged; isolated sandbox available per Pod; repository hooks and persistence named on the Pod page.

risks.title: Navigation change breaks Electron E2E and distribution checks
risks.mitigation: Adapt verify-distribution.mjs and affected existing Electron specs in the same PR; UI is verified with pnpm test:fast (unit plus Vitest browser mode), not with E2E.

risks.title: Group migration loses structure
risks.mitigation: Migrate each group to a tag of the same name before removal; automatic backup; verify counts per tag.

risks.title: Shared shell changes affect the browser workspace
risks.mitigation: Relay deploy first, layout tests at phone and desktop width, then signed desktop build.

verification: All UI behaviour and geometry is verified with Vitest browser mode (test/layout, pnpm test:browser), including screenshots as visual evidence; UI needs no Electron E2E test.
Publish the browser-mode screenshots, after personal inspection, as a Test Run per milestone.
Re-measure the creation of the IURIO rebase test Pod with timestamps per phase; delete the test Pod afterwards.
handoff: Implementation approved. Next action: development issue and branch, then quick wins Q1–Q9 and M1 first. Decisions 3 and 4 are accepted.

links.title: Test Run: UX inventory and creation measurement

changelog.text: Draft created from the UX audit and creation measurement.

Revision 2: az failed in the Pod because HOME is always the Pod state directory, not because of the keychain (follow-up check). Decision 3 now means owner context = owner HOME; tool-specific PAT workarounds are out of scope.
Revision 3: owner accepted decision 3: owner context with the owner HOME is the default for every new Pod; the isolated sandbox is an opt-in add-on. M6 is no longer blocked.
Revision 4: wording per owner: the sandbox is optional if the user wants it, also at creation, not only after the HOME implementation works.
Revision 5: owner accepted decision 4 (per-object approvals) and approved implementation; UI is verified with Vitest browser mode and screenshots, not with E2E.

approval.reference: Owner in chat, 2026-10-13, after reviewing revision 4: "Alles klar. Dann können wir so loslegen. Bzgl der implementation: alles was UI Ist sollte durch Browser-vitest prüfbar sein und muss definitiv nicht durch einen e2e Test. So sollten wir viel schneller prüfen können, selbst wenn wir visuellen Nachweis brauchen"
approval.scope: Start of implementation of this plan. Decision 4 = per-object approvals and the UI test rule from the same message are incorporated in revision 5.

entries.source: Validation accepts a failed result with a reason, or is replaced by a real read-only dry run in the owner session.
entries.text: Die Validierung akzeptiert ein gescheitertes Ergebnis mit Begründung oder wird durch einen echten Nur-Lese-Trockenlauf in der Owner-Sitzung ersetzt.

entries.source: MCP refusals name the field and its place; idempotent workspace commands retry on revision conflicts.
entries.text: MCP-Ablehnungen nennen Feld und Ort; idempotente Workspace-Befehle wiederholen bei Revisionskonflikten.

entries.source: The IURIO rebase test Pod is rebuilt from scratch in under 15 minutes with the shipped git adapter and no validation-only code, measured with timestamps.
entries.text: Der IURIO-Rebase-Test-Pod wird mit dem mitgelieferten git-Adapter und ohne reinen Validierungscode in unter 15 Minuten neu angelegt, gemessen mit Zeitstempeln.

entries.source: Existing grants still match after the parser change (regression test on stored grants).
entries.text: Bestehende Grants passen nach der Parser-Änderung weiterhin (Regressionstest gegen gespeicherte Grants).

entries.source: Revert the PR; adapters are versioned files.
entries.text: PR zurücknehmen; Adapter sind versionierte Dateien.

entries.source: Owner context as creation default, sandbox optional
entries.text: Owner-Kontext als Standard, Sandbox optional

entries.source: Every new Pod uses host CLI logins; isolation is optional per Pod, if the user wants it.
entries.text: Jeder neue Pod nutzt Host-CLI-Logins; Isolation ist pro Pod optional, wenn der User das will.

entries.source: Set HOME to the owner home when reach is owner in main/broker/tools.ts and main/programs/session.ts; keep ~/.config/apes and the Pods folder protected; drop the per-program state directory for owner-context programs.
entries.text: HOME auf dein Home setzen, wenn reach owner ist, in main/broker/tools.ts und main/programs/session.ts; ~/.config/apes und den Pods-Ordner geschützt halten; das programmeigene Speicherverzeichnis für Owner-Kontext-Programme entfällt.

entries.source: Make owner the default level for newly created Pods (MCP create and sandbox apply); existing Pods keep their current level.
entries.text: Owner als Standardstufe für neu angelegte Pods (MCP create und sandbox apply); bestehende Pods behalten ihre Stufe.

entries.source: Offer the isolated sandbox as an optional per-Pod choice, at creation and on the Pod page, whenever the user wants it.
entries.text: Die isolierte Sandbox als optionale Wahl pro Pod anbieten, beim Anlegen und auf der Pod-Seite, wann immer der User das will.

entries.source: A newly created Pod runs in owner context without any sandbox setting, and az repos pr list works in it with the host login.
entries.text: Ein neu angelegter Pod läuft ohne Sandbox-Einstellung im Owner-Kontext, und az repos pr list funktioniert darin mit dem Host-Login.

entries.source: A Pod can be created directly in the isolated sandbox when the user chooses it.
entries.text: Ein Pod lässt sich direkt in der isolierten Sandbox anlegen, wenn der User das wählt.

entries.source: Switching a Pod to isolated still blocks ~/.azure and keeps its grants unchanged.
entries.text: Wird ein Pod auf isoliert umgestellt, bleibt ~/.azure gesperrt und seine Grants bleiben unverändert.

entries.source: Revert the PR; new Pods fall back to isolated with the Pod HOME.
entries.text: PR zurücknehmen; neue Pods fallen auf isoliert mit Pod-HOME zurück.

entries.source: One approval per push
entries.text: Eine Freigabe pro Push

entries.source: Each program effect on one object needs its own IdP approval.
entries.text: Jede Programmwirkung auf ein Objekt braucht eine eigene IdP-Freigabe.

entries.source: Check the DDISA grants specification for object approvals of program actions; record any deviation for the owner.
entries.text: Die DDISA-Grant-Spezifikation für Objektfreigaben von Programmaktionen prüfen; Abweichungen dir vorlegen.

entries.source: Extend the approvals batch beyond mail.archive to git.push with object branch@sha.
entries.text: Die Freigabe-Sammlung über mail.archive hinaus auf git.push mit Objekt branch@sha erweitern.

entries.source: On a disposable test repository, a first push waits for one IdP approval and a second push to a new SHA waits for a new approval.
entries.text: Auf einem Wegwerf-Test-Repository wartet ein erster Push auf eine IdP-Freigabe und ein zweiter Push auf einen neuen SHA auf eine neue Freigabe.

entries.source: Revert the PR; exact command grants remain the fallback.
entries.text: PR zurücknehmen; exakte Befehlsgrants bleiben die Rückfallebene.

entries.source: Owner HOME widens what a Pod can do
entries.text: Dein HOME erweitert, was ein Pod kann

entries.source: Owner decision (decision 3); IdP grant per command unchanged; isolated sandbox available per Pod; repository hooks and persistence named on the Pod page.
entries.text: Deine Entscheidung (Entscheidung 3); IdP-Grant pro Befehl unverändert; isolierte Sandbox pro Pod verfügbar; Repository-Hooks und Persistenz auf der Pod-Seite benannt.

entries.source: Navigation change breaks Electron E2E and distribution checks
entries.text: Navigationsänderung bricht Electron-E2E und Distributionsprüfung

entries.source: Adapt verify-distribution.mjs and affected existing Electron specs in the same PR; UI is verified with pnpm test:fast (unit plus Vitest browser mode), not with E2E.
entries.text: verify-distribution.mjs und betroffene bestehende Electron-Specs im selben PR anpassen; UI wird mit pnpm test:fast (Unit plus Vitest-Browser-Modus) geprüft, nicht mit E2E.

entries.source: Group migration loses structure
entries.text: Gruppenmigration verliert Struktur

entries.source: Migrate each group to a tag of the same name before removal; automatic backup; verify counts per tag.
entries.text: Jede Gruppe vor dem Entfernen in einen gleichnamigen Tag überführen; automatische Sicherung; Anzahl pro Tag prüfen.

entries.source: Shared shell changes affect the browser workspace
entries.text: Änderungen an der gemeinsamen Shell betreffen den Browser-Arbeitsbereich

entries.source: Relay deploy first, layout tests at phone and desktop width, then signed desktop build.
entries.text: Zuerst das Relay ausrollen, Layouttests in Handy- und Desktopbreite, dann signierter Desktop-Build.

entries.source: All UI behaviour and geometry is verified with Vitest browser mode (test/layout, pnpm test:browser), including screenshots as visual evidence; UI needs no Electron E2E test.
entries.text: Alles Sichtbare und seine Geometrie wird mit Vitest im Browser-Modus geprüft (test/layout, pnpm test:browser), inklusive Screenshots als visueller Nachweis; UI braucht keinen Electron-E2E-Test.

entries.source: Publish the browser-mode screenshots, after personal inspection, as a Test Run per milestone.
entries.text: Die Screenshots aus dem Browser-Modus nach eigener Prüfung pro Meilenstein als Test Run veröffentlichen.

entries.source: Re-measure the creation of the IURIO rebase test Pod with timestamps per phase; delete the test Pod afterwards.
entries.text: Das Anlegen des IURIO-Rebase-Test-Pods mit Zeitstempeln pro Phase neu messen; Test-Pod danach löschen.

entries.source: Implementation approved. Next action: development issue and branch, then quick wins Q1–Q9 and M1 first. Decisions 3 and 4 are accepted.
entries.text: Umsetzung freigegeben. Nächster Schritt: Entwicklungs-Issue und Branch, dann zuerst Quick Wins Q1–Q9 und M1. Entscheidungen 3 und 4 sind getroffen.

entries.source: Draft created from the UX audit and creation measurement.
entries.text: Entwurf aus UX-Audit und Messung des Anlegens erstellt.

entries.source: Revision 2: az failed in the Pod because HOME is always the Pod state directory, not because of the keychain (follow-up check). Decision 3 now means owner context = owner HOME; tool-specific PAT workarounds are out of scope.
entries.text: Revision 2: az scheiterte im Pod, weil HOME immer das Pod-Speicherverzeichnis ist, nicht wegen des Schlüsselbunds (Nachprüfung). Entscheidung 3 heißt jetzt Owner-Kontext = dein HOME; tool-spezifische PAT-Umwege gehören nicht in den Plan.

entries.source: Revision 3: owner accepted decision 3: owner context with the owner HOME is the default for every new Pod; the isolated sandbox is an opt-in add-on. M6 is no longer blocked.
entries.text: Revision 3: Entscheidung 3 getroffen: Owner-Kontext mit deinem HOME ist Standard für jeden neuen Pod; die isolierte Sandbox ist ein optionaler Zusatz. M6 ist nicht mehr blockiert.

entries.source: Revision 4: wording per owner: the sandbox is optional if the user wants it, also at creation, not only after the HOME implementation works.
entries.text: Revision 4: Wortlaut nach deiner Vorgabe: Die Sandbox ist optional, wenn der User das will, auch schon beim Anlegen, nicht erst nach funktionierender HOME-Umsetzung.

entries.source: Revision 5: owner accepted decision 4 (per-object approvals) and approved implementation; UI is verified with Vitest browser mode and screenshots, not with E2E.
entries.text: Revision 5: Entscheidung 4 (Objekt-Freigaben) getroffen und Umsetzung freigegeben; UI wird mit Vitest im Browser-Modus und Screenshots geprüft, nicht mit E2E.
